generated.description: ISO date of last pipeline run

publisher.description: e.g. Medium, dev.to, personal blog, YouTube, GitHub

kind.description: 'docs' is reserved for first-party vendor documentation (Microsoft Learn, official release notes). It is the strongest trust signal on the sources page, so do not use it for community writing.

covers.description: Free-form topic tags, e.g. csharp-15, unions, openapi, pqc

writtenAgainst.description: Build the piece was written against, e.g. '.NET 11 Preview 4'. Drives the preview-drift check.

previewDrift.description: Verdict on how far the piece has drifted from current behaviour. 'none' = still accurate. 'minor' = cosmetic/API-name drift, still teachable. 'major' = the central claim no longer holds; explain in driftNote and never cite without the correction.

driftNote.description: Required when previewDrift is 'minor' or 'major': what specifically changed, and what the current behaviour is.

verification.description: 'pending' is the intake state: captured but not yet vetted. Pending records never ship to the site - build-sources.ps1 emits verified records only.

usageTier.description: 1 = reference/link only, 2 = attributed insight restated in our words, 3 = short attributed quote

summary.description: Our own description - never copied from the source

quote.description: Optional short attributed quotation. Requires usageTier 3. Always rendered with attribution and a link.

cachePath.description: Relative path under content/cache/ if fetched
